rationale: Shifted away from the dark/lime 'fintech bro' aesthetic to a warm, organic, and trustworthy palette. Finance often causes anxiety; earthy tones (terracotta, bone white, moss green) introduce calm, clarity, and approachability. This fits the 'refresh design' request perfectly by doing the exact opposite of generic tech patterns.

auth.layout: Split screen on desktop (grid-cols-2), full screen stacked on mobile. Left/Top side: Minimalist login form with generous spacing. Right/Bottom side: Earthy texture background image.

home_dashboard.greeting: h2 format, left aligned. Include user avatar on the top right.
home_dashboard.surplus_card: Hero metric card. Huge Cabinet Grotesk font for the amount. Use terracotta text for emphasis.
home_dashboard.bucket_visual: Horizontal stacked progress bar showing percentages, distinct earthy colors (terracotta, moss, ochre, clay).

expenses.filter_chips: Horizontal scrollable row of chips. Active chip should have a solid #F0EFEA background and #1C1B1A text with border-transparent.
expenses.list_items: Flex row, optical alignment for emojis, crisp border-b border-[#EAE8E3] for separation.

paid_celebration.confetti: Use canvas-confetti package. Trigger from the center of the screen when a debt hits 100%.
paid_celebration.empty_state: If no debts paid, show a warm, encouraging message with an earthy abstract Phosphor icon (e.g., Smiley, Sparkle).

media_assets.description: Warm, earthy minimalist paper texture for the authentication screen background.
Professional smiling neutral avatar for user profile placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject these color hexes directly into tailwind.config.js as custom properties or use them via inline utility classes.
Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT use standard Tailwind colors like blue-500, green-500, or any generic slate colors unless matching the hexes provided.

Implement the Layout Rules strictly: cards should be flat, with exactly 1px border-[#EAE8E3], and rounded-md or rounded-lg (max 8px). Do NOT add large drop shadows to cards, use the subtle hover shadow defined.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons, keeping stroke weight consistent (regular or light).
For all headings and primary balance numbers, import and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' font. Use 'Manrope' for body text, data lists, and small labels. Remember to add 'tracking-tight' to headings.
Data-testid attribute MUST be included on all buttons, links, inputs, tabs, and interactive cards to enable automated testing (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Implement bottom mobile navigation with framer-motion layout animations for the active tab indicator.

Avoid heavy Shadcn component wrappers for basic cards if it complicates overriding styles; standard divs with Tailwind are preferred to ensure the custom border and padding rules are perfectly applied.
